question.text: A child swinging on a swing in sitting position, stands up, then the time period of the swing will

options.text: increases if the child is tall and decreases if the child is short

solution.text:
$\mathrm{T}=2 \pi \sqrt{\mathrm{l}_{\mathrm{eff}} / 8} ; 
\mathrm{l}_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases when the child stands up.
